reviews.text: Our vet referred us over for an ultrasound. Our large dog is not the best patient, but the team completing the ultrasound were great with him and knew how to keep him as happy and safe as possible. Was very impressed by and appreciative of the team.
Exceptional service and so happy I was in the room with my pet and give real time information as needed.
Everyone was terrific, so helpful and professional. My dog needed an ultrasound and the entire staff was so kind and made me feel like my Rosie was in good hands. I would definitely recommend VDC .
Everyone was very nice.  The procedure was explained in great detail and all our questions were addressed.  Our dog is very reactive and they were great with him.

We just left our appointment at Veterinary Diagnostic Centers and had a phenomenal experience. We brought in our 8 year old cockapoo for an echocardiogram and were a little nervous about how she would do. The environment in the clinic is so welcoming and doesn’t feel like a vets office at all. Every single one of the staff members were so warm, welcoming, and patient with our pup. Their communication with us prior to the appointment was also great - prompt communication and they work with you to ensure you are getting the correct service based on your pets needs without paying extra for something you don’t need. I highly recommend this clinic!
1 animal here at a time, that is so helpful for the more bashful of the bunch. EVERYONE here is so very nice, and they were great with my cat. Highly recommend!
Very thoughtful and caring staff. Results were explained clearly and they did a great job making sure my dog was relaxed and comfortable the whole time
The staff took such great care of my pup! It was awesome that I was able to be with him during the ultrasound…I believe it eased both of us!

We took our cat here for an ultrasound. I am so happy with the services we received. The team was very kind and communicative and gentle with our cat. He felt very comfortable with them, even without sedation. The facilities were very nice and they have a calming environment with low lighting and calm music. They were also accommodating over the holiday weekend and let us know the test results with little delay. When we were going through such a stressful time with our pet I was so grateful to have a relatively stress-free appointment here. I would go back here in the future if ever needed.

Before scheduling with Veterinary Diagnostic Center I read the google reviews and was skeptical that they had all these 5 star rave reviews, so I vowed to add to the list if my experience was also as great as others had claimed. And guess what...it's real! I've been to many veterinarians in Chicago and this is about as good as it gets, especially for specialty care. Not only was the price about half of what MedVet charges for an ultrasound, they were easy to schedule with, super kind, very up front about pricing and all it includes, and quick to call me with a thorough explanation of the results the following day! I went to the location on Irving Park Rd and it is a quiet, calming environment with super friendly staff-people. They were so sweet to my anxious Chihuahua and made us both feel well taken care of.
The care received here was excellent. My  dear cat had an ultrasound and the techs were wonderful, and calming. Also the internist delivered detailed results and next steps. Highly recommend them!
Thank you very much for your patience and gentleness with Maxie

Took my 13 year old pitbull for an abdominal ultrasound just a few days ago. From the moment of scheduling to the visit was superb. My dog was not in good health and had an accident in the lobby and the front desk lady didn’t blink an eye or make me feel bad or guilty for his accident. She immediately told me not to worry.

The tech who took our information and more details as well as the ultrasound technician were so kind with my boy.

He was very comfortable in the room, and they even dimmed the lights and had relaxing ambient music playing.

Their attention to detail and customer service in a time where I was very stressed and worried made this experience so much easier for me.

I appreciate their price transparency before the appointment however at the end of the appointment they suggested we send report same day (and a call back with results) for an additional fee. We were the last appointment of the day so I assume that is why they recommended the same day report.

Unfortunately due to financial reasons we only came prepared for the initial estimate, if you want immediate results I would recommend you ask beforehand just in case.  I wish I would have known before but by no means am I faulting the ladies for that. Just a suggestion for future clients.

Overall, I would absolutely recommend this location and know that they are very kind and gentle with your pet. Which is the absolute most important.

I’m sorry I don’t recall your names, but once again thanks to those 3 ladies who attempted to me and my dog.

I took my cat for an ultrasound and it was the smoothest process. From making the appointment, ultrasound time to discussing results, everyone made the stressful process extremely easy. The room we were had relaxing jazz music; my cat nearly fell asleep! Every employee handled my boy with care, attention and made me very welcomed as I sat with them in the room.

Results were provided promptly (within 24 hours) and sent to my vet. I would strongly recommend anyone to go here!
Incredible level of care. Extremely professional; they do a top notch job of ensuring the least stressful experience for owners and companion animals.
It was great that I was able to be with my dog throughout the ultrasound. I think it helped calm both of us. I was able to make an appointment easily online and knew clearly what the fees would be.

My large dog (100lbs) had to get an ultrasound of his abdomen, and the staff were absolutely wonderful with him, treating him gently and with such care. The whole experience was much nicer than I was expecting.

At a time when we had no clue as to what was going on with our pet, Veterinary Diagnostic Centers were able to provide answers. Eternally grateful to them and the staff who helped us through a difficult, mysterious time.

They are expensive but worth it. The staff is so sweet, patient and kind. We have had 2 dogs come here now for ultrasounds and they did everything possible to make me and my furry little guys comfortable.
Quick professional service. qualified personnel.

I had a great experience taking my senior pup here to get an ultrasound. The techs were incredibly kind throughout the entire procedure and took extra care to make my dog feel less scared. It really helped that I was able to be in the room to sit with her the entire time as well. Results came back same day. I would definitely use VDC again for future needs.

Veterinary Diagnostics Center on Irving Park Rd was excellent. The person I spoke with to schedule the appointment took the time to walk me through the details of what to expect for my cat's echo cardiogram and she was patient in answering our questions. We were able to get an appointment quickly, which was great because we were worried about our kitty.

On the day of the appointment, the same person greeted me and asked us some additional questions and reminded us of what to anticipate. Your pet has to stay still during the appointment, and their team was so gentle in keeping our cat in place. It was also great that we could be there with our cat to pet her and try to keep her calm during the procedure.

The results were ready the next day and we received a call from a cat cardiologist who walked us through the findings and recommendations. They also answered our questions and then followed up with notes of what we discussed. They also automatically send the report and recommendations to your regular vet so they have the records. We will need to get echos for our cat every 1-2 years, so we will definitely go back to VDC.

Everyone was so caring and wonderful, both for our precious cat GG, and for us. We loved it that they only do one patient at a time leading to less stress for all of us. I can't say enough wonderful things about them. GG's prognosis is frankly not well but when they followed up to report the results of her test, they were compassionate and kind.

They were absolutely amazing and super patient with my very wiggly kitty!!! Super understanding and showed the absolute most professionalism and kindness to me and my cat pretzel. She was most definitely acting like her name and trying to squirm almost the entire time! But they got the job done! Couldn’t be happier with their work! Would definitely work with them again if I needed too!

I had a great experience taking my 14 yr old pup for an ultrasound! Was very easy to make an appointment, and everyone I encountered was very pleasant. I’m glad I was able to be there with my pup the whole appointment as she has separation anxiety. The internist called the next day with her results, and was very thorough explaining the situation.
Dr Bloomberg was amazing! Went in with my cat needing fine needle aspirate. Staff was friendly and supportive.

The diagnostic experience with our small dog was excellent.  Being with our dog while they completed the ultrasound, the care that the technicians took in keeping her calm and comfortable eased my mind. The thorough explanation of the procedure before and after with the veterinarian were exemplary. They provide emails and transcripts of all interactions including the test results.  I highly recommend their diagnostic services.
Great experienced, caring drs.

I can’t say enough good things about Veterinary Diagnostics Center in Schaumburg. When my 5-year-old Boston Terrier Phoebe was diagnosed with a heart murmur by my primary vet, I took her in for an echocardiogram and from the moment I walked in, the entire experience was calm and genuinely compassionate.

Tammy, Kim, and Genesis were kind, organized, and friendly — which mattered a lot because this kind of appointment can be really stressful as a pet parent.  I left feeling informed, supported, and grateful that Phoebe was in such capable hands. If you need specialty diagnostics or cardiology testing for your pet, I would absolutely recommend Veterinary Diagnostics Center. You will be the only one in there for the appointment which is nice, your pet has free reign of the space!  You are with your dog the whole time during the procedure.  They got the results back to me within 48 hours and they will send them to your primary vet at the same time with recommendations on what to do next.
Thank you to the whole team for taking such great care of Phoebe!

The staff here was absolutely incredible! They were extremely kind and patient with my cat who gets stressed very easily. They took all measures to make sure she was comfortable and even allowed me to be in the room with her. Exceptional service.
Seamless process, easy to get an appointment, and the staff are all very nice and clearly love animals.  I would go here for any specialist need.

Great experience, start to finish. Everyone is patient, kind, and thorough. You’re allowed to accompany your pet during the procedure which is huge - I’ve never seen my dog so relaxed in a veterinary facility. The technicians are phenomenal, too! Quick turnaround on results and both the report and the phone call are very detailed and well-explained. Ultrasound reports are reviewed by a board certified internal medicine specialist and are sent directly to your veterinarian as well. Can’t recommend them highly enough!

I was extremely pleased with my experience. The team was professional, efficient, and made the entire process seamless. I received a call with the results by the next morning, and the level of detail provided exceeded my expectations. Having timely and thorough information made a stressful situation far more manageable.

The staff was also incredibly kind and reassuring, which helped keep my dog calm throughout the appointment. Their professionalism and compassion truly set them apart. I highly recommend this facility to anyone needing diagnostic imaging for their pet.

I can’t say enough good things about the team and the care they provide. It’s easy to get an appointment, very calm environment, and the ability to stay with my dog the entire time she was getting her ultrasound is hands down the best experience. Highly recommend!

My elderly cat got TLC during his ultrasound appointment. Their gentle, fear free approach was appreciated. I’m a level three certified fear free veterinarian (retired) so I know what to look for. They got us in quickly and took the time needed to get a good history.
Cared for my Lotus. Gentle and  precise. Fast!

Had a wonderful experience bringing my dog to get an ultrasound. My pup and I were nervous but the team took good care of us. They called same day and I felt a huge sense of relief. I highly recommend!

The entire staff was amazing! They made the whole process easy for my very anxious dog and myself.
Highly recommended
They were very thorough and kept my cat calm during the procedure. I loved that I was able to stay with to comfort him while he got his imaging done. Thank you!

We had such great experience at VDC! The staff was incredible and overall everything about this was done completely stress free!
Our 16 year old cockapoo, Leia, had bloodwork done that showed she is anemic. We were told that an ultrasound might give us an idea what is causing this. I will start by saying that our pup had an ultrasound a few years ago someplace else for another issue and I was not impressed. We waited in a waiting room full of dogs and owners for about ½ hour before they took her. My husband and I continued to wait in the waiting room while they did the procedure.
I did some on-line searches and found VDC. I made the appointment on-line and was contacted with details including what we needed to do prior to the appointment and they let me know that they had already reached out to our Vet to get her records.
We arrived 15 minutes early as requested so that we could go over health details. There was no full waiting room… It was just us!... All focus was on our little furball. We were told what to expect during the ultrasound (shaved belly, on her back for the procedure) and that we can be in the room with her. The room was very calm and comfortable with low light and some nice serene music. We were seated at her head, the technician on one side and an assistant on the other who was petting Leia during the procedure. 20 minutes later, we were done.
I highly recommend Vet Diagnostic Center! Words cannot express how grateful I am that we found VDC.

Absolutely exceptional staff- they were amazing, really know what they’re doing, and they have a heart for it! My reactive dog didn’t bark even once, despite needing to be on his back and handled by strangers the entire time. Calm, reassuring, safe, and very professional at the same time. 12/10.

The staff here was excellent. We came here for an ultrasound and the vet/techs discovered our dog needed immediate surgery. They had us set up to go to the emergency vet in minutes. Very professional and attentive staff made our stressful situation much more manageable.
VDC was able to get my dog in the same day for an ultrasound which was instrumental in her diagnosis. They are a truly compassionate group of people. Highly recommend!
Very kind, gentle and professional staff

Brought my dog in for an ultrasound and to take some tissue samples to send to the lab. Everything was very satisfactory. All the staff were professional and the vet answered all of my questions. Thank you!

The VDC team did a wonderful job creating a fear free/ low stress environment for my dog during her ultrasound. They had low lights, soothing music, calming spray and comfortable pillows to keep my dog as calm as possible. She was the only client at that time to reduce stress. We were able to be present during the ultrasound to pet and comfort our dog along with a few vet techs. Their staff was so kind and I could tell they really cared about us and our dog.

Update: I was back at VDC a couple years later since my first visit and had an equally stellar experience. Took my cat in for another ultrasound and they were great with handling an anxious cat who doesn't like to sit still. The report was comprehensive and completed by a board-certified internist. Results were provided to me less than 24 hours later. The staff here are top notch, very kind, and thorough. They allow you to stay with your pet during ultrasounds which makes everyone's experience better, most importantly the pet. I was also able to schedule just a day in advance which is fantastic. Can't recommend VDC highly enough.
--------------
Had a great visit here with my cat for an ultrasound which are typically hard to find appointments for. So thankful this place opened up as a much needed resource for the community. The team here was so friendly. Highly recommend.

My dog was nervous about being on her back, but the techs were so gentle and comforting that my pup calmed down. They were very professional, and understanding while creating a comforting experience.  Thank you

Veterinary Diagnostic Center in Portage Park is an excellent facility for pet diagnostics.   The staff were knowledgeable, professional and very pleasant. They were kind and attentive to my dog during the entire procedure.  The facility is very clean and uses up-to-date equipment.  The staff explained the entire procedure, informing me that I will be contacted by a physician with the results of my dog’s abdominal ultrasound.  I received a call from the veterinarian physician later that afternoon. He explained the test results in detail and also sent the complete report to me and my primary veterinarian.  I was completely satisfied with the excellent services provided  and so was my dog!  Additionally, I was provided with the exact cost of the procedure when I scheduled the exam.

Wonderful experience!  They were able to get my cat in quickly for an ultrasound appointment.  The office has a calm and soothing atmosphere and everyone working there is so kind and caring with your pet.  I will definitely be going here in the future when I need imaging services.

I was very impressed with the ease of scheduling an appointment, competitive pricing, promptness in getting us in for the appointment, clear instructions for preparing for the appointment, the kindness, friendliness, and extreme professionalism of the team. Follow up was excellent. Recommend 100%.

We felt so welcome from the moment we arrived. The atmosphere is calm and serene, with a peaceful energy that really put us at ease. My usually fearful boy did so much better than I expected.  The room was  warm and inviting and I was able to be in it with him. To whisper in his ear “it’s ok, mamas here” helped immensely.

They GET fear free.

When I mentioned that he loves singing to Whitney Houston, they said, “Alexa, play Whitney!” He even tried to sing the chorus — not easy when you’re lying on your back, but it was such a sweet, memorable moment. What a great experience. 100% recommended.

Diagnostics are stressful and to be able to avoid ER hospitals just makes sense.

Thank you Dr Bloomberg and staff.

Staff was friendly and professional. Very efficient and results provided in a timely manner. Highly recommend if your pet doesn’t require an ER visit. Price was competitive. Would definitely use them for future imaging needs
Our experience was great and everyone was so kind to our dog
Office was immaculate and welcoming.  Staff was professional and kind.  Results were forwarded to our vet and shared with me quickly.  Very grateful for the service provided.  Thank you.

I brought here my cat for an abdominal ultrasound. I booked through their website in an emergency situation. They worked with me after explaining the risks of showing up without proper preparation. The booking process is easy, you will get an email with an estimate, there is plenty street parking, and they have some light refreshments.
The most important thing though is that all the staff seem genuinely happy to work there and I was welcomed so gracefully in such a vulnerable moment. My kitty was handled so gently and lovingly. They weren’t just holding her down they were keeping her comfortable, monitoring her, cuddling her as much as possible while in a very uncomfortable position, while conversing with me and making me feel safe and comfortable. I will recommend this place to everyone, forever. Thank you so much for your kindness!

I had such a good experience here. Anyone with pets, specifically senior ones that are sick, know how frustrating and anxiety inducing the process can be to try to get any sort of diagnosis in a timely manner. Veterinary Diagnostic Centers made it easy and without having to make an initial appointment to a specialty vet clinic and then wait for an ultrasound appointment (while also nickel and diming you for everything). I was able to make one within the week and the best part is they allow you to be in the room with your pet. As someone with a special needs and anxious/reactive dog, this is such a huge plus. Anna, Blanca, and Peter were very kind, friendly, and professional. Very highly recommended!
Had a great experience. The entire staff was kind, knowledgeable. I booked an appointment online and was seen 2 days later. The doctor called with the results 1st thing Monday .

Friendly and professional staff. I felt welcomed and comfortable to bring in my fur baby. My cat was handled with love and her ultrasound was performed with care and not rushed. They took their time and imaged all the important organs. I loved it and 100% recommend this diagnostic center. I received the results the same day- a few hours after it was completed. Definitely a 5 star center.

When I got there, they were absolutely fantastic with Max. They took him right away. They let me be in there. They were just wonderful. With Max. The best ever
Then the next day, the doctor that read Max‘s ultrasound called me right in the morning, explained everything so I could understand it. He was wonderful. He said there were a few things that could be done once I talk to my vet.
I would recommend this place to go to for any of your animals

Really appreciated how easy and smooth the entire process was. I was able to book a last-minute ultrasound for my cat online, and when he needed a second procedure, they got him in right away. Everyone I interacted with was super kind and professional. The ultrasound report and internal medicine consult were very detailed and thorough, and provided me guidance on next steps. I got a clear estimate ahead of time and was able to stay with him the whole time. Grateful this place exists!

I needed to get an ultra sound for my cat who is a nervous nelly. All the other referrals I called told me I would need to bring my cat into the ER to have her sedated, which meant I way paying out the nose AND could have stayed there for hours. I called VDC and Erika was so sweet and I could tell over the phone that I had made the right decision! When I arrived, it was quiet, met with Erika and staff at the front and they all assured me things would be okay. The decorations here are amazing as well!! The procedure lasted all of 30 minutes and they reported she did a great job, which made me glad I found this place!!!! HIGHLY RECOMMEND!

Today we done the ultrasound at this clinic and we had a really good experience.
Stuff is very polite and friendly.  I highly recommend this place

Awesome experience with our Mary. Great team! It was so great that she fell asleep during the ultra sound. I received a call from Dr. Bloomberg the evening after the appointment to follow up. Highly recommend.

We really appreciate the staff here. Our old, anxious dog had a good experience with the abdominal ultrasound. The staff was very patient and did not push us to sedate our pet. They allowed she time to get comfortable and also comforted her during the ultrasound. The result came back the same day and the Dr answered all our questions over the phone.

We took our pup for a follow up ECG and the staff was wonderful with him. My pup was treated well and was relaxed throughout the whole process. He even was awarded the best patient of the day (even though it was only 9:30am)😂 …
Very professional, knowledgeable, clean, friendly, but most importantly they were very kind to my baby Shih Tzu. They kept her calm through the procedure and snuggled her the entire time 🩷. …

I would 100% recommend them. They asked me lots of questions, they were nice, patience and true dogs lover. They let me stay in with my dog why he was doing the ultrasound which helped because he didn’t need the anesthesia. I will surely come back to them in case of need. They also texted me before calling me to let me know the results, which helped because I was at work and I had the time to go in a room and take the call. Also, they sent me immediately the response via email. I went to a different clinic last time and it took me over three weeks to get  what I paid for. Thank to the wonderful staff! Joy also thanks all of you!!

My senior cat Stewart was able to be seen right away for an echocardiogram and results were received in under 24 hours. Dr Bloomberg and staff were professional, caring and highly knowledgeable and their facility was beautiful and clean. Highly recommend for any of hour pet’s diagnostic needs 👍🏻 …

Our dog, who can be pretty anxious and fearful with new vets/locations needed an abdominal ultrasound. The team at veterinary diagnostic centers was amazing at creating a safe, calm environment for him. We were able to stay with him, and he even took a little nap during the ultrasound. Great experience!
Staff was very kind and helped put my dog at ease during test

The staff are welcoming and professional.  They are gentle and patient with both the pet and owner.  Everything is explained in detail.  They work as a team to ensure that procedures are complete and correct. The building is clean and quiet 🤫 ensuring everyone is comfortable.
The coffee was pretty good too! Ha ha

If you need an ultrasound for your pet immediately, this is the place to go.  Totally compassionate staff and professional atmosphere.  We had the ultrasound done on our dog at 1:00 p.m. and had the results later that day.  The doctor was caring and informative and answered all of our questions.  Hands down the best experience we have had with a veterinary service in a long time.  Thank you so very much for offering this service - it appears it's very much needed!  Highly recommend!!!

Dr. Bloomberg and his staff—especially Anna—made what would have been a distressing experience for both pet and owners as peaceful and easy as possible. Unfortunately, the ultrasound did not yield the answers or revelations we would have liked and we ended up needing to suddenly put down our cat, Penny, two days later. That being the case, the doctor and his team were fully invested in their part of Penny's care, and for that we are still immensely grateful. Thank you.
Great staff great service

I was able to get a next day appointment for an abdominal ultrasound for my cat. Amazing!! The appointment started and ended on time, and I was able to stay with my baby the whole time. The experience was so much better than going to the ER vet. Highly recommend if you need diagnostics for your pet!!

I was so relieved by my experience here. I was very fragile having to take my cat in unexpectedly and they were very gentle and flexible when I kept changing my mind on my appointment time. Everyone had a very warm presence and they were very professional. I’m so happy my cat was in their care for her ultrasound, they kept her calm and showered her with compliments 😸 thank you for everything!

Came in for a blood pressure test for my senior dog, Lady. The staff was incredibly kind and helped reassure her, even bringing out a blanket for her to lay on. Super grateful to have found this place!
Everyone was very communicative and reassuring throughout the entire process while still going out of their way to accommodate us and our pup.

Really high quality and affordable!
I appreciate the service offered! I am a fellow vet med professional and really enjoyed connecting with the team while getting my pets ultrasound done! Thank you for your compassionate care!
Thank you Christine!
Absolutely phenomenal quality of care and caring. Wish I could give more than five stsrs.

Wonderful staff and great team working together to make my 12 year FEMALE PUG “CHEWLA” experience so special and so much more fun than just being in a lonely room.. the outcome was amazing thank you again A+ service

Prompt friendly professional and knowledgeable from check in through exam and check out. Pet cared for patiently and kindly.  Results delivered in less than 24 hours with helpful suggestions for ongoing care. Highly recommended.

Friendly, knowledgeable staff. Very clean office and easy to get to.
Follow-Up with physician to discuss results was prompt and thorough.

Awesome Experience
Caring Professionals
My Petey needed an ECG and they booked me within 24 hours.  The Cardiologist called me and explained things so I fully understood the results which were GREAT.
I was on a wait list 2-5 weeks out at other locations. So happy I found this amazing  veterinary diagnostic center.

Everyone here was really helpful and understanding during a difficult time for our family.  They made our visit easy and called back immediately when they received our cat's results.  Would highly recommend!

Everyone was very nice and professional. Even though my Chewie was very anxious and nervous, they were very patient and understanding.  I also received the results the following day from the doctor which I really appreciate.  Thank you.

What a fabulous gem! A place to take our pets for imaging. It sounds easy but it’s not. The staff were incredible! So compassionate and efficient. They made a stressful situation much less stressful for Pinnochio Rose and her humans.
